objects.description: Primary application singleton for ZNC. Manages configuration, users, listeners, modules, networking, SSL settings, traffic stats, and connection queues. Provides lifecycle control (CreateInstance/Get/DestroyInstance), configuration parsing/writing, and various operational utilities. It privately inherits from CCoreTranslationMixin. Destruction/ownership of many contained pointers is handled internally; consult implementation for exact semantics.
Enumeration of configuration/update states used by CZNC to signal pending operations like rehashing, writing config (normal/verbose), delayed write, and shutting down.

objects.definition: typedef std::pair<unsigned long long, unsigned long long> TrafficStatsPair;
objects.description: Alias representing a pair of traffic counters: <bytes in, bytes out>. Used for aggregating traffic statistics per user/network and totals.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<CString, TrafficStatsPair> TrafficStatsMap;
objects.description: Map from identifier (typically username or network name) to a TrafficStatsPair, used by CZNC for reporting traffic statistics.
C-style ABI header passed from a module to ZNC core. Contains version strings, compile options, and a callback to fill CModInfo for the module.
Helper base for capability lifecycles that depend on server/client CAP state. Modules subclass this to react to changes; CModule wires instances via AddServerDependentCapability.
Module-owned cron/timer task derived from CCron. Schedules periodic jobs for a module; stores module pointer and description.

objects.definition: typedef void (*FPTimer_t)(CModule*, CFPTimer*);
objects.description: Function pointer type for CFPTimer callbacks: callback(CModule*, CFPTimer*). Pointer form here is pointer-to-function pointer.
CTimer variant invoking a C-style callback on each tick via RunJob(). Stores FPTimer_t and calls it with (module,this).
Thread job wrapper safe for module unload: automatically cancelled on unload. Available only when built with pthread support.

objects.definition: typedef void* ModHandle;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a dynamically loaded module (e.g., dlopen handle).
Holds metadata and factory for a module: name/path/description, supported types, default type, and a loader function pointer. Also provides translation helper and type-to-string utility.
Represents a command provided by a module, with a callback and localized help. Can be registered with CModule to handle module-specific commands.

Primary base class for ZNC modules. Exposes extensive hook API for IRC, client, web, capability, and lifecycle events; manages timers, sockets, jobs, commands, persistent NV storage, and translation. Instances are constructed by loader functions pointed to by CModInfo.
Container/manager for multiple CModule instances associated with a user/network/client. Forwards events to modules, and provides APIs to load/unload/reload modules and discover available ones.

Abstract base class for authentication flows initiated by a client connection. Holds username/password and a socket reference, and provides AcceptLogin/RefuseLogin orchestration calling subclass hooks (AcceptedLogin/RefusedLogin). Instances can be invalidated to detach from the socket. Copying is disabled.
Concrete auth handler bound to a CClient. Implements AcceptedLogin/RefusedLogin and nulls its CClient pointer on invalidate. Used for client-driven login or SASL authentication.
direct_api_constructors: CClientAuth::CClientAuth(CClient* pClient, const CString& sUsername, const CString& sPassword)

objects.description: Represents a connected IRC client socket (inherits CIRCSocket). Manages authentication, capabilities negotiation (CAP), tag filtering, SASL, forwarding messages between the client and IRC network, and status/mod notices. Non-copyable. Holds pointers to CUser and CIRCNetwork, state flags for supported capabilities, and helpers for buffering and channel attach/detach.

Primary network object for ZNC representing a single IRC network profile owned by a user. Manages servers, channels, queries, clients, connection state, authentication, buffering of messages (raw/MOTD/notice), nick/identity, TLS trust settings, flood control, and timers. Inherits privately from CCoreTranslationMixin (defined elsewhere). Constructors require a CUser* and network name; copy operations are deleted. Destruction will free owned resources via implementation in source (not visible here).

IRC server connection socket class for ZNC, derived from CIRCSocket. Manages IRC protocol I/O, CAP negotiation, flood control, user/channel state, and tag support for a single network connection. Non-copyable. Contains nested enum EChanModeArgs and numerous message handlers. Construction requires a CIRCNetwork*. Destruction follows base socket semantics; explicit destructor declared. Ownership: holds pointers/references to network and channels but does not define their lifetimes here.

Enumeration describing how channel modes take arguments, aligning with CHANMODE tokens from numeric 005: modes with list arguments, modes that always have an argument, modes that have an argument only when set, and modes with no argument.

ZNC-specific socket class extending Csock with translation support and additional SSL/TLS verification and encoding helpers. Provides certificate verification hooks, SNI configuration, and policy controls (trust-all, trust-PKI, pinned fingerprints). Contains an internal protected unnamed enum with a custom errno value for bad SSL certificates.

objects.definition: enum EAddrType { ADDR_IPV4ONLY, ADDR_IPV6ONLY, ADDR_ALL };
objects.description: Enumeration selecting which address families to listen/connect on: IPv4-only, IPv6-only, or both (all). Used by socket manager listen/connect helpers to set address family requirements.

Socket manager specialized for CZNCSock. Provides helpers to listen/connect on TCP and UNIX domain sockets, optionally with SSL and address-family selection. Manages in-flight DNS resolution, with optional threaded DNS via nested TDNSTask struct and CDNSJob class. Also integrates translation mixin.

Convenience base class for sockets owned by ZNC modules. Extends CZNCSock with module association, translation helpers, safety defaults (readline enabled, max buffer handling), and simplified Connect/Listen utilities that auto-register with the manager. Non-copyable.

Socket specialization for IRC protocol traffic (client<->ZNC and ZNC<->server). When ICU is available, custom converter callbacks allow certain IRC control characters to pass through encoding conversions.

Abstract base class for listeners which accept incoming connections for ZNC. Encapsulates common state like SSL flag, URI prefix, and accept-type policy, and owns a CRealListener socket when actively listening. Provides a pure-virtual Listen() and a virtual ToConfig(). Deletion is non-copyable. SetupSSL is available for derived classes. Lifetime of CRealListener is managed via m_pListener; ResetRealListener is provided. Construction details for m_pListener occur in implementation (not shown).

objects.definition: typedef enum { ACCEPT_IRC, ACCEPT_HTTP, ACCEPT_ALL } EAcceptType;
objects.description: Enumeration nested in CListener that controls which kinds of connections to accept: IRC, HTTP, or all. Use with CListener and derivatives to filter incoming connections.

Concrete listener that binds a TCP socket on a given port and address family to accept IRC/HTTP connections per EAcceptType. Stores bind host, port, and address type (EAddrType is external). Overrides Listen() to start listening and ToConfig() to serialize settings. Non-copyable; destructor handles cleanup of underlying socket via base mechanisms.

Concrete listener for UNIX domain sockets. Listens on a filesystem path with specified group and permission mode (stored internally as m_iMode; exposed via GetMode()). Accepts per EAcceptType and can be SSL-enabled if supported by underlying transport. Non-copyable; destructor and Listen()/ToConfig() implemented elsewhere.

Socket implementation that actually listens on the network or UNIX socket and delegates accepted connections to its owning CListener. Overrides CZNCSock callbacks to create appropriate per-connection sockets and handle errors. Holds a reference to the owning CListener (non-owning). Lifespan is managed by CListener (m_pListener).

Represents an individual incoming connection socket created by CRealListener. Parses input lines and dispatches according to accept type (IRC vs HTTP) and URI prefix. Overrides ReadLine and buffer-limit handling. Constructed with remote host, port, accept type, and URI prefix. Lifetime is managed by ZNC socket framework; no custom destructor logic in header.

objects.definition: typedef std::shared_ptr<CWebSubPage> TWebSubPage;
objects.description: Alias for a shared pointer to CWebSubPage. Used to manage subpage objects with shared ownership semantics.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<TWebSubPage> VWebSubPages;
objects.description: Vector of shared pointers to CWebSubPage, representing a collection of web subpages.
Template tag handler for ZNC web interface. Bridges template rendering with CWebSock to resolve custom tags. Lifetime does not own the referenced CWebSock.

Represents a web UI session identified by ID and client IP. Tracks associated user (if logged in), last activity time, and per-session success/error messages. Non-copyable; managed externally (often via shared_ptr). Destruction, storage, and TTL behavior are handled by session map elsewhere.
Describes a web subpage entry with a name, translatable title, optional parameters, and flags (e.g., admin-only). Lightweight value-type; parameters can be augmented via AddParam.

Cache map from session ID to shared_ptr<CWebSession> with a TTL-based eviction policy. Provides a helper to terminate all sessions for a given user. Constructor accepts TTL in milliseconds (inferred; exact units not documented here).

HTTPS socket handler for ZNC’s web interface. Routes page requests, performs login, renders templates or static files, manages per-connection session access, skins, cookies, and CSRF checking. Uses async capabilities via PAGE_DEFERRED. Owns a template instance and references auth and session objects.

Abstract base class for template tag handling hooks. Subclass and override HandleVar/HandleTag/HandleIf/HandleValue to provide custom behavior when CTemplate processes variables, tags, conditionals, and value post-processing. Default implementations return false (not handled) except HandleIf which delegates to HandleVar.
Holds per-template processing options, currently escape-conversion settings (from/to encodings as CString::EEscape). Provides Parse to load options from a line of text.

Runtime context for iterating a named loop within a template. Tracks loop name, current row index, reverse traversal flag, file position of the loop tag, whether data exists, and the vector of row templates.

Primary template-processing class derived from MCString. Loads template files, manages search paths, loops and their rows, variable/tag evaluation, printing to streams or strings, and integrates custom tag handlers and options. Owns loop contexts and an options object (shared_ptr), and may reference a parent template for inheritance of handlers.

Primary parsed IRC message container. Holds sender (CNick), command, parameters, tags, timestamp, and links to network/client/channel. Provides parsing, serialization, tag/time access, and lightweight casting to specialized message views. Sub-enum Type classifies message kind; FormatFlags control ToString formatting. Subclasses must not add data members (same size as CMessage). Construction/destruction specifics not shown here.

objects.definition:
enum class Type {
        Unknown,
        Account,
        Action,
        Authenticate,
        Away,
        Capability,
        ChgHost,
        CTCP,
        Error,
        Invite,
        Join,
        Kick,
        Mode,
        Nick,
        Notice,
        Numeric,
        Part,
        Ping,
        Pong,
        Quit,
        TagMsg,
        Text,
        Topic,
        Wallops,
    };
objects.description: Enumeration of high-level IRC message types used by CMessage to classify the parsed command. Values are not guaranteed stable across versions.
Bitmask flags for CMessage::ToString controlling which parts of a message are included in serialization (prefix and/or tags).
Mutable view of CMessage for commands that have a target (first parameter), e.g., PRIVMSG/NOTICE/CHANNEL events. No additional storage; operates on base parameters.
View for /me ACTION messages (CTCP ACTION). Encodes/decodes the text in CTCP ACTION framing in parameter 1.
View for SASL AUTHENTICATE payloads; treats first parameter as the authentication data/text.
View for CTCP requests and replies. Uses NOTICE vs PRIVMSG to distinguish replies; wraps/unwraps CTCP delimiter characters around param 1.
View for JOIN messages. First param is channel (target), second is optional key.
View for MODE messages. Param 0 is target; param 1 is mode string; subsequent params are mode arguments. Provides helpers to split parameters.
View for NICK change events. Old nick from prefix (CNick), new nick from first parameter.
View for NOTICE messages with a target and text in param 1.
View for numeric replies; exposes the numeric command code parsed from the command string.
View for KICK events. Param 0 target channel, param 1 kicked nickname, param 2 reason (also exposed as text).
View for INVITE messages. Param 0 is the nick being invited, param 1 is the channel name.
View for PART events. Param 0 is the channel, param 1 is optional part message (also exposed as text).
View for QUIT events. First parameter is the quit message (also exposed as text).
View for text-carrying target messages like PRIVMSG. Param 0 target, param 1 text.
View for TOPIC changes and replies. Param 0 channel, param 1 topic string (also as text).
View for CHGHOST (or similar) events indicating a user's ident/host change; params 0 and 1 hold new ident and host, respectively.

Primary user object of ZNC. Manages per-user configuration, authentication (including password hashing strategy via eHashType), networks, clients, message routing, and preferences like buffers, timestamps, language, and permissions. Non-copyable; constructed with a username and owns/refs networks and modules. Destruction and most behaviors are defined in the implementation file; memory ownership: holds vectors of CIRCNetwork* and CClient* but ownership semantics are not fully specified here.
Enumeration of password hashing methods used for CUser credentials, including a conditional default mapping depending on build-time support for Argon2.

IRC channel abstraction for ZNC. Manages membership (nicks and their permissions), channel modes, topic, key, buffering of messages, and user attach/detach state within a specific CIRCNetwork. Non-copyable; lifecycle is managed externally (likely by the network or user). Provides helpers to mutate/query modes, join/part behavior, buffer management, and topic metadata. Details about construction side-effects and persistence are partly unknown from this header alone.
Enumeration of per-user privilege prefixes used in channel nicklists (e.g., Voice '+', Op '@'). Values correspond to prefix characters.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
        M_Private = 'p',
        M_Secret = 's',
        M_Moderated = 'm',
        M_InviteOnly = 'i',
        M_NoMessages = 'n',
        M_OpTopic = 't',
        M_Limit = 'l',
        M_Key = 'k',
        M_Op = 'o',
        M_Voice = 'v',
        M_Ban = 'b',
        M_Except = 'e'
    } EModes;
objects.description: Enumeration of channel mode letters handled by CChan (private, secret, moderated, invite-only, no-external-messages, topic-ops-only, limit, key, operator, voice, ban, exception). Values map directly to RFC/IRC mode letters.

Represents an IRC nickname entity within ZNC. Tracks the nick, ident, host, and channel permission flags (e.g., '@' for channel operator). Provides parsing from a nickmask, comparison, and helpers to query common channels in a network. Holds a back-reference to the owning CIRCNetwork (not owned) and exposes setters/getters for its fields. Construction, copy, and assignment are available; destructor is trivial. Implementation details and invariants are not present in this header.

Represents an IRC query/private-message context within ZNC. It stores the peer name, the owning network, and a scrollback buffer of messages. Provides APIs to manage and send the buffer to a client. Copying is disabled; instances are uniquely owned/managed by ZNC. Construction requires a name and the CIRCNetwork this query belongs to. Destruction semantics and lifetime ownership are not defined in this header.

Represents a single buffered IRC-style line consisting of a parsed CMessage (format/metadata, time, tags) and a separate text payload. Provides constructors from CMessage or legacy CString format, conversion to CMessage for a client, and utilities to compare/update/access components. Ownership is standalone; no custom allocator indicated. Deprecated members exist for legacy API.

A bounded buffer of CBufLine entries implemented as a private-inherited std::deque. Manages adding/updating lines by CMessage or legacy format strings, retrieving formatted output for a client, size queries, and a configurable maximum line count (m_uLineCount). It owns CBufLine elements.

Represents a filesystem file and exposes utilities for querying metadata, opening/reading/writing, locking (fcntl-based), copying/moving/deleting, and permission changes. Provides static helpers for path queries and a small enum of file types and file attributes. Lifetime: RAII for descriptor; must call Open/Close appropriately. Error state tracked by m_bHadError. Details of implementation and error semantics are not shown in this header.
Enumeration of filesystem object kinds used by CFile to classify entries and for type checks (IsReg/IsDir/... and FType).

objects.definition: enum EFileAttr { FA_Name, FA_Size, FA_ATime, FA_MTime, FA_CTime, FA_UID };
objects.description: Enumeration of sortable file attributes; used by directory listings for sorting behavior. Defined within CFile and referenced by CDir.

Directory helper that inherits from std::vector<CFile*> and manages a collection of CFile entries for a directory. Provides fill-by-wildcard, bulk chmod/delete, path checking and creation helpers, and current working directory retrieval. Owns contained CFile pointers and deletes them in CleanUp/Destructor.

Config entry wrapper that can optionally hold a pointer to a nested CConfig (sub-config). Provides value semantics via copy/move operations and manages m_pSubConfig lifetime in its implementation (details not visible here).

In-memory representation of a ZNC configuration. Stores key→multi-value entries and hierarchical sub-config sections tagged by name. Provides parsing from and writing to files, as well as helpers to query and consume entries with various types.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<CString, VCString> EntryMap;
objects.description: Map from configuration key to a vector of string values (multi-valued entries). Nested inside CConfig; used as the primary store for key/value pairs.

objects.definition: typedef std::pair<CString, CConfigEntry> SubConfigEntry;
objects.description: Name–entry pair representing a single named sub-configuration instance under a tag. The first is the instance name; the second wraps the sub-config payload.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<SubConfigEntry> SubConfig;
objects.description: Ordered collection of named sub-config entries for a given tag.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<CString, SubConfig> SubConfigMap;
objects.description: Map from sub-config tag (e.g., section type) to a list of named sub-config instances.

objects.definition: typedef EntryMap::const_iterator EntryMapIterator;
objects.description: Const iterator type for iterating over EntryMap. Provided for API convenience.

objects.definition: typedef SubConfigMap::const_iterator SubConfigMapIterator;
objects.description: Const iterator type for iterating over SubConfigMap. Provided for API convenience.

Abstract HTTP socket handler for ZNC. Inherits from CSocket and provides HTTP parsing, header/cookie management, parameter parsing (GET/POST), auth hooks, and response helpers (headers, redirects, error pages, file serving). It declares a pure virtual GetSockObj and OnPageRequest, so users subclass CHTTPSock to implement request handling and socket creation. Construction expects a CModule owner and a URI prefix, optionally hostname/port/timeout for outbound. Details like CString, VCString, MCString, Csock, CSocket, CFile are defined elsewhere.
direct_api_constructors: CHTTPSock(CModule* pMod, const CString& sURIPrefix, const CString& sHostname, unsigned short uPort, int iTimeout = 60)

objects.description: Holds translation metadata for a translation entry. Exposes a static method to retrieve a map of available translations keyed by CString. Contains at least the self/display name of the translation (sSelfName). No constructors or lifecycle specifics are provided here.

Singleton translation manager shared by all modules. Provides singular/plural translation lookup in a domain/context, manages a stack of active languages, and reference counting for per-domain resources. Stores loaded locales per domain and language. Construction is via the static Get() accessor; no public constructor is exposed here.

RAII helper to push a language upon construction and pop it on destruction, affecting the active translation language in the current scope. Likely interacts with CTranslation::PushLanguage/PopLanguage, though the implementation is not shown here.

RAII holder that probably increments a reference count for a translation domain on construction and decrements it on destruction (matching CTranslation::NewReference/DelReference). Stores the target domain name as an immutable CString.

Lightweight object representing a translation query to be resolved later. Holds domain, context, and the English source text. Resolve() performs the lookup and returns the translated CString at call time.

A wrapper that can hold either a raw CString or a CDelayedTranslation. Resolve() returns the contained string directly or resolves the delayed translation, enabling APIs to accept either pre-translated text or a deferred translation handle.

A mixin providing static helpers for translation in core code (non-modules). Likely wraps CTranslation to provide singular/plural translation and inline formatting. It returns CInlineFormatMessage for formatted strings and CDelayedTranslation for deferred resolution. No data members; intended to be inherited.

objects.definition: using CMutex = std::mutex;
objects.description: Alias for a non-recursive mutex; wraps std::mutex and is used to protect shared data structures within the thread pool and related code.

objects.definition: using CMutexLocker = std::unique_lock<std::mutex>;
objects.description: Alias for a RAII mutex locker using std::unique_lock<std::mutex>. Ensures a CMutex (std::mutex) is unlocked on scope exit.

objects.definition: using CConditionVariable = std::condition_variable_any;
objects.description: Alias for a condition variable allowing waiting/notifying with arbitrary lock types. Used to coordinate worker threads in the pool.

Abstract base class representing a unit of work executed by the thread pool. runThread() runs on a worker thread; runMain() is invoked on the main thread after completion. Tracks state via EJobState and supports cancellation queries via wasCancelled(). Instances are owned and deleted by CThreadPool after completion when submitted.

objects.definition: enum EJobState { READY, RUNNING, DONE, CANCELLED };
objects.description: Enumeration of the lifecycle states of a CJob: READY (not yet started), RUNNING (executing on a worker), DONE (completed), CANCELLED (cancellation requested/processed).

Thread pool singleton that dispatches CJob instances to worker threads, manages synchronization, cancellation, and notification to the main thread via a pipe. Owns submitted CJob objects and deletes them when finished.

Utility class providing various static helpers for I/O, hashing, time formatting/parsing, user input, and network helpers. Mostly used as a namespace; constructors/destructors are trivial and not documented here. Details of CString/SCString/MCString come from other headers.
Lightweight exception object carrying a type enum indicating shutdown or restart. Provides GetType(). Intended to be thrown/caught within ZNC control flow.

objects.definition: typedef enum { EX_Shutdown, EX_Restart } EType;
objects.description: Enumeration type nested in CException indicating the reason/type of exception: shutdown or restart. Only accessible as CException::EType in C++ code.

A printable table/list builder built atop vector<vector<CString>>. Supports grid and list styles, adding columns/rows, setting cells, and generating formatted output lines. Manages column widths internally.

objects.definition: enum EStyle { GridStyle, ListStyle };
objects.description: Style selector for CTable rendering: GridStyle (boxed table) or ListStyle (two-column list with bold keys). Use as CTable::EStyle.

Singleton-like utility class providing process-wide debug configuration and filtering for debug output. Exposes static setters/getters to toggle debugging and record whether stdout is a TTY, plus a Filter() helper to post-process lines before emission. Holds two static data members declared here (definitions provided in a source file).

RAII debug output stream derived from std::ostringstream. Instances are created temporarily (e.g., by the DEBUG macro) to accumulate a message; its destructor is responsible for emitting the buffered string to stdout/stderr if debugging is enabled. Only the destructor is declared here; its implementation resides in a source file.

objects.definition: typedef std::set<CString> SCString;
objects.description: Alias for a set of CString values; provides ordered, unique collection semantics for CString.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<CString> VCString;
objects.description: Alias for a vector (dynamic array) of CString values; preserves insertion order and allows duplicates.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<std::pair<CString, CString>> VPair;
objects.description: Alias for a vector of key/value pairs of CString, useful for ordered lists of string pairs.

objects.definition: enum class CaseSensitivity { CaseInsensitive, CaseSensitive };
objects.description: Strongly-typed enum expressing whether string operations should be case-insensitive or case-sensitive.

Primary ZNC string class extending std::string with rich utilities for case handling, escaping, tokenization, splitting, formatting, hashing, encoding/decoding (base64), optional encryption, numeric conversions, trimming, and miscellaneous helpers. It defines EEscape for escape modes. Construction and destruction follow std::string semantics; many methods return new CString or modify in place.
Enumeration nested in CString specifying escape/encoding contexts (ASCII, URL, HTML, SQL, named-format, debug, message tags, hex-colon). Used by Escape/Escape_n methods.

Dictionary mapping CString to CString with convenience I/O: serialize/deserialize to disk with overridable filters and simple escaping via Encode/Decode. Provides status codes for I/O results. Owns no external resources beyond the std::map; destructor clears the map.
Enumeration of status/error codes used by MCString::WriteToDisk and MCString::ReadFromDisk.

Helper for inline named formatting. Stores a format string and, when invoked, builds a parameter map {"1": arg1, "2": arg2, ...} and calls CString::NamedFormat. Stateless aside from the stored format.
MD5 working context holding running bit counts (total), the current hash state (state), and a 64-byte processing buffer (buffer). Used internally by CMD5 methods to compute MD5 digests.

C++ class wrapper for computing MD5 hashes. Stores the hex string digest in m_szMD5 (33 bytes including NUL). Provides constructors to hash provided text, conversion operators to string and char*, and a MakeHash function. Internally implements the MD5 algorithm via md5_starts/update/finish/process using md5_context.

objects.definition:
#ifndef uint8
#define uint8 unsigned char
#endif
objects.description: Typedef-like macro alias for an 8-bit unsigned integer type. Used for MD5 byte buffers.

objects.definition:
#ifndef uint32
#define uint32 unsigned long int
#endif
objects.description: Typedef-like macro alias for a 32-bit unsigned integer type. Used for MD5 counters and state words.

SHA-256 hashing context structure holding running state across init/update/final operations. Fields include total processed length, current buffered length, a two-block buffer for incoming data, and the eight 32-bit working hash state words.

The listed names are functions, not data types. No typedefs or struct/class/enum definitions are provided for these; they are ignored per instructions. This placeholder documents that no additional custom data types besides sha256_ctx exist in this header.
Built-in type referenced by the declaration. Not a custom type; included here for completeness is not required. No custom types are defined in this header.
CString is referenced from included headers but not defined here. This header does not define CString.

Represents an IRC server endpoint configuration within ZNC, including hostname (m_sName), port (m_uPort), optional password (m_sPass), and connection flags for SSL (m_bSSL) and Unix domain socket (m_bUnixSocket). Provides comparison operators for ordering/equality, accessors, a formatter to string, validation of hostnames, and a static Parse factory to construct a CServer from a line/string. Destructor and constructors are declared here; definitions are expected in the corresponding source file.
direct_api_constructors: CServer(const CString& sName, unsigned short uPort = 6667, const CString& sPass = "", bool bSSL = false, bool bUnixSocket = false)

objects.definition: extern const char* ZNC_VERSION_EXTRA;
objects.description: Pointer to a C string containing extra version information for ZNC, declared here for external linkage. The actual storage is defined elsewhere. Note: this is a declaration, not a definition.

objects.definition: extern bool ZNC_NO_NEED_TO_DO_ANYTHING_ON_MODULE_CALL_EXITER;
objects.description: External boolean flag symbol exposed by this header. Used as a no-op target for module-callback macros that expect a boolean exit flag pointer. Not defined here; only declared.

objects.definition: #define NOTHING &ZNC_NO_NEED_TO_DO_ANYTHING_ON_MODULE_CALL_EXITER
objects.description: Preprocessor macro that expands to the address of the external boolean flag ZNC_NO_NEED_TO_DO_ANYTHING_ON_MODULE_CALL_EXITER. Intended to be passed where a bool* out-parameter is required but the caller does not care about the result. Note: as a macro, it is not a type; provided here for completeness because it behaves like a constant of type bool*.

A socket wrapper class that executes an external command and connects the child process' stdin/stdout to the socket using pipe-based file descriptors. It derives from CZNCSock (defined elsewhere). Execute() forks/execs via popen2(), wiring read/write FDs into the underlying socket. Kill() sends a signal to the child process and closes the socket. The destructor ensures pipes and process are closed via close2() and clears socket FDs. Details of popen2()/close2() implementations are not provided here.

CString is a ZNC string class used throughout the codebase. In this header it is not defined; it is only referenced via a macro alias CS_STRING. Since there is no definition here, details such as storage, API, or lifetime are unknown from this file.

functions.name: CZNC::CZNC
functions.description: Default constructor for the ZNC core singleton class. Initializes internal state, managers, and configuration fields.

functions.name: CZNC::~CZNC
functions.description: Destructor for the ZNC core singleton class. Cleans up allocated resources, sockets, timers, and owned objects as needed.

functions.name: CZNC::DeleteUsers
functions.description: Deletes users that have been scheduled or marked for deletion from the ZNC instance.

functions.name: CZNC::Loop
functions.description: Runs the main event loop of ZNC, processing network events and timers via the socket manager.

functions.name: CZNC::WritePidFile
functions.description: Writes the given process ID to the PID file for process supervision.
requirements: iPid: should represent a valid process ID (non-negative).
PID file path must have been set up by initialization routines (e.g., InitDirs) for writing to succeed.

functions.name: CZNC::DeletePidFile
functions.description: Removes the PID file created by WritePidFile.
requirements: Must be called only after a PID file has been created, otherwise it may be a no-op or fail depending on filesystem state.

functions.name: CZNC::WaitForChildLock
functions.description: Blocks until a lock file or child lock condition is cleared, used to avoid race conditions with other processes/instances.

functions.name: CZNC::IsHostAllowed
functions.description: Checks whether a host (or hostmask) is allowed to connect, based on ZNC configuration such as allowed hosts and proxies.
requirements: sHostMask must contain a host or hostmask string.

functions.name: CZNC::AllowConnectionFrom
functions.description: Determines if a connection from the provided IP address should be accepted, e.g., enforcing anonymous connection limits.
requirements: sIP must be an IP address string.

functions.name: CZNC::InitDirs
functions.signature: void CZNC::InitDirs(const CString& sArgvPath, const CString& sDataDir)
functions.description: Initializes ZNC directory paths such as home, data, module, and configuration directories using the provided executable path and data directory.
requirements: sArgvPath should be the path to the running executable or its directory.
sDataDir should be a valid directory path; may be created if absent depending on configuration.

functions.name: CZNC::OnBoot
functions.description: Performs startup initialization such as loading configuration, listeners, modules, and preparing runtime state.

functions.name: CZNC::ExpandConfigPath
functions.signature: CString CZNC::ExpandConfigPath(const CString& sConfigFile, bool bAllowMkDir /*= true*/)
functions.description: Expands a configuration file path to an absolute path under the ZNC configuration directory; may create parent directories if allowed.
requirements: sConfigFile must be a path or filename.
If bAllowMkDir is true, the process must have permission to create required directories.

functions.name: CZNC::WriteNewConfig
functions.description: Creates and writes a new configuration file at the given path with default or current settings.
requirements: sConfigFile must be a writable path where the config should be created.

functions.name: CZNC::WriteConfig
functions.description: Writes the current in-memory configuration to the configured config file, optionally delayed by the config write timer.
requirements: The configuration system must be initialized (e.g., config file path known).

functions.name: CZNC::ParseConfig
functions.signature: bool CZNC::ParseConfig(const CString& sConfig, CString& sError)
functions.description: Parses the provided configuration data (file contents) and updates in-memory configuration. On error, populates sError.
requirements: sConfig must contain the configuration text to parse.
sError is an output parameter and will be filled with an error message on failure.

functions.name: CZNC::RehashConfig
functions.description: Reloads and applies the configuration (rehash) without a full restart. Populates sError on failure.
requirements: sError is an output parameter and will be filled with an error message on failure.

functions.name: CZNC::BackupConfigOnce
functions.description: Creates a one-off backup of the current configuration using the provided suffix to distinguish the backup file.
requirements: sSuffix is appended to the backup filename.

functions.name: CZNC::GetVersion
functions.description: Returns the ZNC version string.

functions.name: CZNC::GetTag
functions.signature: static CString CZNC::GetTag(bool bIncludeVersion /*= true*/, bool bHTML /*= false*/)
functions.description: Returns a descriptive ZNC tag string, optionally including version and optionally formatted for HTML.

functions.name: CZNC::GetCompileOptionsString
functions.description: Returns a string describing the compile-time options and features ZNC was built with.

functions.name: CZNC::GetUptime
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string indicating the server's uptime since startup.

functions.name: CZNC::ClearBindHosts
functions.description: Deprecated since 1.7.0. No-op placeholder that used to clear allowed bind hosts.
requirements: Do not use in new code.

functions.name: CZNC::AddBindHost
functions.description: Deprecated since 1.7.0. No-op that always returns false; previously added an allowed bind host.
requirements: Do not use in new code.

functions.name: CZNC::RemBindHost
functions.description: Deprecated since 1.7.0. No-op that always returns false; previously removed an allowed bind host.
requirements: Do not use in new code.

functions.name: CZNC::ClearTrustedProxies
functions.description: Clears the list of trusted proxy hosts configured in ZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::AddTrustedProxy
functions.description: Adds a host to the list of trusted proxies.
requirements: sHost must be a host or address string.

functions.name: CZNC::RemTrustedProxy
functions.description: Removes a host from the list of trusted proxies.
requirements: sHost must be a host or address string already present in the trusted proxy list.

functions.name: CZNC::GetClientCapBlacklist
functions.description: Returns the set of IRCv3 capability names which ZNC should not advertise to clients.

functions.name: CZNC::GetServerCapBlacklist
functions.description: Returns the set of IRCv3 capability names which ZNC should not request from servers.

functions.name: CZNC::Broadcast
functions.signature: void CZNC::Broadcast(const CString& sMessage, bool bAdminOnly /*= false*/, CUser* pSkipUser /*= nullptr*/, CClient* pSkipClient /*= nullptr*/)
functions.description: Sends a message to all connected clients/users, optionally only to admins, and optionally skipping a specific user or client.
requirements: sMessage should be non-empty to have an effect.
pSkipUser and pSkipClient may be nullptr to skip nothing.

functions.name: CZNC::AddBytesRead
functions.description: Accumulates the number of bytes read by the server for traffic statistics.

functions.name: CZNC::AddBytesWritten
functions.description: Accumulates the number of bytes written by the server for traffic statistics.

functions.name: CZNC::BytesRead
functions.description: Returns the total number of bytes read since startup.

functions.name: CZNC::BytesWritten
functions.description: Returns the total number of bytes written since startup.

functions.name: CZNC::GetTrafficStats
functions.signature: CZNC::TrafficStatsMap CZNC::GetTrafficStats(TrafficStatsPair& Users, TrafficStatsPair& ZNC, TrafficStatsPair& Total)
functions.description: Collects and returns traffic statistics per user, also filling aggregate counters for all users, ZNC-only traffic, and overall totals.
requirements: Users, ZNC, and Total are output parameters and will be set by the function.

functions.name: CZNC::GetNetworkTrafficStats
functions.signature: CZNC::TrafficStatsMap CZNC::GetNetworkTrafficStats(const CString& sUsername, TrafficStatsPair& Total)
functions.description: Returns traffic statistics per network for the specified user, and fills Total with the aggregate traffic for that user across networks.
requirements: sUsername must identify an existing user for meaningful results.
Total is an output parameter and will be set by the function.

functions.name: CZNC::AuthUser
functions.description: Initiates authentication for a user using the provided authentication object; results are returned via callbacks on CAuthBase.
requirements: AuthClass must be a valid shared_ptr to an authentication handler which will receive callbacks.

functions.name: CZNC::SetConfigState
functions.description: Sets the current configuration state, thread-safely using an internal mutex.

functions.name: CZNC::SetSkinName
functions.description: Sets the name of the web interface skin to use.

functions.name: CZNC::SetStatusPrefix
functions.description: Sets the status prefix used for internal status entities. If s is empty, the prefix is set to "*".

functions.name: CZNC::SetMaxBufferSize
functions.description: Sets the maximum buffer size used for message playback/buffers.

functions.name: CZNC::SetAnonIPLimit
functions.description: Sets the limit for how many anonymous connections are allowed per IP.

functions.name: CZNC::SetServerThrottle
functions.description: Sets the server connection throttle interval in seconds (converted internally to milliseconds).

functions.name: CZNC::SetProtectWebSessions
functions.description: Enables or disables additional protections for web sessions (e.g., CSRF protection).

functions.name: CZNC::SetHideVersion
functions.description: Configures whether ZNC should hide its version in public responses.

functions.name: CZNC::SetAuthOnlyViaModule
functions.description: If enabled, only modules are allowed to perform authentication, not built-in methods.

functions.name: CZNC::SetConnectDelay
functions.description: Sets the delay in seconds before attempting to connect networks from the queue.

functions.name: CZNC::SetSSLCiphers
functions.description: Sets the OpenSSL/TLS cipher list string for outgoing and/or listener sockets.

functions.name: CZNC::SetSSLProtocols
functions.description: Configures which SSL/TLS protocol versions to allow, based on a protocol list string. Returns false if the string is invalid or unsupported.
requirements: sProtocols must be a protocol selection string understood by ZNC/underlying SSL library.

functions.name: CZNC::SetSSLCertFile
functions.description: Sets the path to the SSL certificate file to use.
requirements: sFile should point to an accessible certificate file.

functions.name: CZNC::SetConfigWriteDelay
functions.description: Sets the delay (seconds) before writing configuration changes to disk.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConfigState
functions.description: Returns the current configuration state, reading it under a mutex for thread safety.

functions.name: CZNC::GetManager
functions.description: Returns a reference to the socket manager controlling sockets and the event loop.
requirements: Returned reference must not outlive the CZNC instance.

functions.name: CZNC::GetModules
functions.description: Returns a reference to the global modules manager.
requirements: Returned reference must not outlive the CZNC instance.

functions.name: CZNC::GetSkinName
functions.description: Returns the currently configured web skin name.

functions.name: CZNC::GetStatusPrefix
functions.description: Returns the current status prefix string.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid as long as the CZNC instance exists or until the prefix is changed.

functions.name: CZNC::GetCurPath
functions.description: Returns the current working directory path used by ZNC.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the CZNC instance exists.

functions.name: CZNC::GetHomePath
functions.description: Returns the ZNC home directory path.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the CZNC instance exists.

functions.name: CZNC::GetZNCPath
functions.description: Returns the path to the ZNC installation directory.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the CZNC instance exists.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConfPath
functions.description: Returns the absolute path to the configuration directory. May create it if allowed.
requirements: If bAllowMkDir is true, process must have permissions to create the directory if missing.

functions.name: CZNC::GetUserPath
functions.description: Returns the base directory path for user data files.

functions.name: CZNC::GetModPath
functions.description: Returns the directory path where modules are stored.

functions.name: CZNC::GetPemLocation
functions.description: Returns the filesystem path for the default PEM (certificate+key) file used by ZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::GetKeyLocation
functions.description: Returns the filesystem path for the default private key file used by ZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::GetDHParamLocation
functions.description: Returns the filesystem path for the Diffie-Hellman parameter file used by ZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConfigFile
functions.description: Returns the path to the current configuration file.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid as long as the CZNC instance exists or until the value changes.

functions.name: CZNC::WritePemFile
functions.description: Writes or updates the PEM/SSL material to disk, such as certificate, key, and DH params, if required.
requirements: Process must have permissions to write to the PEM/SSL file locations returned by GetPemLocation/GetKeyLocation/GetDHParamLocation.

functions.name: CZNC::GetBindHosts
functions.description: Deprecated since 1.7.0. Returns the legacy list of allowed bind hosts.
requirements: Do not use in new code.
Returned reference remains valid while the CZNC instance exists.

functions.name: CZNC::GetTrustedProxies
functions.description: Returns the list of trusted proxy hostnames/IPs.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the CZNC instance exists.

functions.name: CZNC::GetListeners
functions.description: Returns the list of active listeners managed by ZNC.
requirements: Pointers in the returned vector are owned by CZNC and remain valid until the listener is removed or CZNC is destroyed.

functions.name: CZNC::TimeStarted
functions.description: Returns the time (epoch) when ZNC was started.

functions.name: CZNC::GetMaxBufferSize
functions.description: Returns the maximum buffer size for message playback/buffers.

functions.name: CZNC::GetAnonIPLimit
functions.description: Returns the configured limit of anonymous connections per IP.

functions.name: CZNC::GetServerThrottle
functions.description: Returns the server connection throttle interval in seconds.

functions.name: CZNC::GetServerThrottle
functions.description: Checks if the server identified by sName is currently throttled (returns true if throttled).
requirements: sName identifies a server.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConnectDelay
functions.description: Returns the delay (seconds) used before connecting queued networks.

functions.name: CZNC::GetProtectWebSessions
functions.description: Returns whether extra web session protection is enabled.

functions.name: CZNC::GetHideVersion
functions.description: Returns whether ZNC hides its version in responses.

functions.name: CZNC::GetAuthOnlyViaModule
functions.description: Returns whether only modules are allowed to perform authentication.

functions.name: CZNC::GetSSLCiphers
functions.description: Returns the configured SSL/TLS cipher list string.

functions.name: CZNC::GetSSLProtocols
functions.description: Returns the configured SSL/TLS protocol selection string.

functions.name: CZNC::GetDisabledSSLProtocols
functions.description: Returns the internal bitmask of disabled SSL/TLS protocols, mapped to Csock::EDisableProtocol.

functions.name: CZNC::GetSSLCertFile
functions.description: Returns the path to the SSL certificate file in use.

functions.name: CZNC::GetAvailableSSLProtocols
functions.description: Returns a list of SSL/TLS protocol strings supported by the build/SSL library.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConfigWriteDelay
functions.description: Returns the configured delay (seconds) before writing configuration to disk.

functions.name: CZNC::CreateInstance
functions.description: Allocates and initializes the global CZNC singleton instance.
requirements: Must be called before Get() if no instance exists.
Should be called at most once before DestroyInstance().

functions.name: CZNC::Get
functions.description: Returns a reference to the global CZNC singleton instance.
requirements: CreateInstance() must have been called before, or an instance must otherwise exist.
Returned reference remains valid until DestroyInstance().

functions.name: CZNC::DestroyInstance
functions.description: Destroys the global CZNC singleton instance and frees associated resources.
requirements: Should only be called once when shutting down.

functions.name: CZNC::FindUser
functions.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the user with the given username, or nullptr if not found.
requirements: sUsername is the user's login name.

functions.name: CZNC::FindModule
functions.signature: CModule* CZNC::FindModule(const CString& sModName, const CString& sUsername)
functions.description: Finds a module by name for a specific user by username. Returns nullptr if not found.
requirements: sModName is the module's name.
sUsername is the target user's name.

functions.name: CZNC::UpdateModule
functions.description: Reloads a module everywhere (global, per-user, and per-network): unloads then loads it again.
requirements: sModule is the module's name to reload.
Running clients may be affected during reload.

functions.name: CZNC::DeleteUser
functions.description: Deletes the specified user account from ZNC.
requirements: sUsername must identify an existing user to succeed.

functions.name: CZNC::AddUser
functions.signature: bool CZNC::AddUser(CUser* pUser, CString& sErrorRet, bool bStartup /*= false*/)
functions.description: Adds a new user to ZNC. On failure, returns false and sets sErrorRet.
requirements: pUser should point to a properly initialized CUser instance; ownership semantics are determined by implementation.
sErrorRet is an output parameter set on failure.
bStartup indicates this add occurs during startup (affects behavior).

functions.name: CZNC::GetUserMap
functions.description: Returns the map of usernames to CUser pointers for all users known to ZNC.
requirements: Pointers are owned/managed by CZNC; do not delete them.

functions.name: CZNC::FindListener
functions.signature: CListener* CZNC::FindListener(u_short uPort, const CString& BindHost, EAddrType eAddr)
functions.description: Finds a TCP listener matching the specified port, bind host, and address family.
requirements: uPort is the port to search.
BindHost is the bind address/host.
eAddr specifies the address type (e.g., IPv4/IPv6).

functions.name: CZNC::FindUnixListener
functions.description: Finds a UNIX domain socket listener by filesystem path.
requirements: sPath is the path to the UNIX socket.

functions.name: CZNC::AddListener
functions.description: Adds a pre-constructed listener object to ZNC's listener set.
requirements: The CListener* should be a valid, heap-allocated listener prepared for activation.
Ownership after addition is by CZNC (do not delete externally) — exact semantics depend on implementation.

functions.name: CZNC::AddTCPListener
functions.signature: bool CZNC::AddTCPListener(unsigned short uPort, const CString& sBindHost, const CString& sURIPrefix, bool bSSL, EAddrType eAddr, CListener::EAcceptType eAccept, CString& sError)
functions.description: Creates and adds a TCP listener with the given parameters (port, bind host, optional URI prefix, SSL, address type, and accept mode).
requirements: sError is an output parameter set on failure.

functions.name: CZNC::AddUnixListener
functions.signature: bool CZNC::AddUnixListener(const CString& sPath, const CString& sURIPrefix, bool bSSL, CListener::EAcceptType eAccept, const CString& sGroup, const CString& sMode, CString& sError)
functions.description: Creates and adds a UNIX domain socket listener at the specified path with the given options (URI prefix, SSL, accept mode, group, mode).
requirements: sPath must be a filesystem path where the UNIX socket can be created.
sGroup and sMode specify group ownership and permissions (format depends on implementation).
sError is an output parameter set on failure.

functions.name: CZNC::DelListener
functions.description: Removes and destroys the specified listener from ZNC.
requirements: Pointer must refer to a listener previously added to ZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::SetMotd
functions.description: Sets the Message of the Day (MOTD) to a single line, replacing any existing lines.

functions.name: CZNC::AddMotd
functions.description: Appends a line to the MOTD if the line is non-empty.

functions.name: CZNC::ClearMotd
functions.description: Clears all MOTD lines.

functions.name: CZNC::GetMotd
functions.description: Returns the current MOTD lines.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid as long as the CZNC instance exists or until modified.

functions.name: CZNC::AddServerThrottle
functions.description: Marks a server identified by sName in the throttle cache to avoid reconnecting too quickly.
requirements: sName identifies a server.
Throttle semantics depend on internal TTL setting.

functions.name: CZNC::AddNetworkToQueue
functions.description: Adds the given IRC network to the connection queue for later (re)connection attempts.
requirements: pNetwork should be a valid CIRCNetwork pointer owned/managed appropriately by the caller/CZNC.

functions.name: CZNC::GetConnectionQueue
functions.description: Returns a reference to the internal connection queue list of networks.
requirements: Modifying the returned list affects CZNC's queue directly.
Do not store dangling references or iterators beyond CZNC's lifetime.

functions.name: CZNC::EnableConnectQueue
functions.description: Ensures a connect-queue timer exists and is active, enabling processing of the connection queue.

functions.name: CZNC::DisableConnectQueue
functions.description: Disables and tears down the connect-queue timer, stopping automatic processing of queued networks.

functions.name: CZNC::PauseConnectQueue
functions.description: Temporarily pauses processing of the connect queue.

functions.name: CZNC::ResumeConnectQueue
functions.description: Resumes processing of the connect queue after a pause.

functions.name: CZNC::ForceEncoding
functions.description: Forces a specific character encoding for connections/messages according to configuration.

functions.name: CZNC::UnforceEncoding
functions.description: Disables forced character encoding and returns to default/negotiated behavior.

functions.name: CZNC::IsForcingEncoding
functions.description: Returns whether forced character encoding is currently enabled.

functions.name: CZNC::FixupEncoding
functions.description: Returns a normalized/adjusted encoding name based on configuration and supported encodings.
requirements: sEncoding is an encoding name string.

functions.name: CZNC::LeakConnectQueueTimer
functions.description: Special-purpose method used only by CConnectQueueTimer's destructor to transfer/avoid deletion semantics for the timer.
requirements: Must only be called from CConnectQueueTimer::~CConnectQueueTimer() as stated in the comment.
pTimer must point to the timer being leaked.

functions.name: CZNC::DisableConfigTimer
functions.description: Disables the delayed configuration write timer so that no pending writes occur.

functions.name: CZNC::DumpConfig
functions.description: Debug/utility function to dump the contents of the given configuration object to logs or stdout.
requirements: Config may be nullptr depending on implementation; if non-null, it should point to a valid CConfig object.

functions.name: ZNCModuleEntry
functions.description: C-style entry point exported by a module. Core calls this to obtain version/compile info and a pointer to a function that fills CModInfo. Usage: defined via MODULEDEFS/...MODULEDEFS macros in a module TU; not called directly by modules.
requirements: Must be defined exactly once per module via MODULEDEFS/NETWORKMODULEDEFS/USERMODULEDEFS/GLOBALMODULEDEFS macros.
Must return a valid pointer to a static CModuleEntry whose first field (pcVersion) remains ABI-stable as documented.
Caller (ZNC core) compares version/options strings before using returned info.

functions.name: TModLoad
functions.signature: template <class M> CModule* TModLoad(ModHandle p, CUser* pUser, CIRCNetwork* pNetwork, const CString& sModName, const CString& sModPath, CModInfo::EModuleType eType);
functions.description: Template helper used by MODCOMMONDEFS to instantiate a module object of type M. It simply returns new M(...) forwarding the standard CModule constructor arguments. Used internally by the loader via CModInfo::SetLoader.
requirements: Template parameter M must be a CModule-derived class with constructor M(ModHandle, CUser*, CIRCNetwork*, const CString&, const CString&, CModInfo::EModuleType).
Caller is responsible for ownership and later deletion/unloading of the returned module pointer.
Arguments pUser/pNetwork may be null depending on module type; M's constructor must tolerate that per ZNC design.

functions.name: CModCommand::InitHelp
functions.description: Initializes a CTable to receive command help entries (column layout, headers). Used before adding command help via AddHelp or HandleHelpCommand.
requirements: Table must be a valid, mutable CTable instance passed by reference.
Should be called before AddHelp() or HandleHelpCommand() to ensure consistent columns.

functions.name: CModCommand::AddHelp
functions.description: Adds this command's help entry (name/args/description) into the provided CTable previously prepared by InitHelp.
requirements: Table should have been initialized by CModCommand::InitHelp().
This object must have a valid command name and callable function (constructed properly).

functions.name: CModule::OnLoad
functions.signature: virtual bool CModule::OnLoad(const CString& sArgsi, CString& sMessage);
functions.description: Hook called when a module is loaded. Allows parsing of arguments and returning a user-facing message. Return true on success to keep the module loaded.
requirements: sArgsi contains module arguments as provided by user/config; may be empty.
sMessage may be set to a message to display after loading (e.g., error detail when returning false).
Return false to abort loading; true to keep the module loaded.

functions.name: CModule::OnBoot
functions.description: Hook called during ZNC startup for modules loaded from configuration. Returning false aborts ZNC startup.
requirements: Should perform quick, non-blocking initialization.
Return false only on fatal error conditions that should stop startup.

functions.name: CModule::WebRequiresLogin
functions.description: Indicates whether the module's web UI requires a logged-in user session. Default returns true.
requirements: Return true to enforce login; return false if module supports unauthenticated web access.

functions.name: CModule::WebRequiresAdmin
functions.description: Indicates whether the module's web UI requires admin privileges. Default returns false.
requirements: Should return true only if the web UI exposes admin-only functionality.

functions.name: CModule::GetWebMenuTitle
functions.description: Returns the title to display for the module in the web interface sidebar. Default returns empty string (no custom title).
requirements: Return a short, user-visible title; may be empty to use defaults.

functions.name: CModule::GetWebPath
functions.description: Returns the module’s web path (base URL segment). Default provided by framework (implementation in source).
requirements: Should return a valid URL path segment without trailing slash if overridden.

functions.name: CModule::GetWebFilesPath
functions.description: Returns filesystem path where the module’s static web files reside. Default provided by framework (implementation in source).
requirements: If overridden, return an accessible filesystem directory path.

functions.name: CModule::OnWebPreRequest
functions.signature: virtual bool CModule::OnWebPreRequest(CWebSock& WebSock, const CString& sPageName);
functions.description: Pre-dispatch hook for web requests. If returns true, the module must finish handling the request and close the socket (e.g., for non-templated or streaming responses). If false, normal subpage dispatch follows.
requirements: If returning true, the handler must call WebSock.Close() (or otherwise complete and close the response).
Must not rely on subpage permission checks when returning true; you fully handle the request.

functions.name: CModule::OnWebRequest
functions.signature: virtual bool CModule::OnWebRequest(CWebSock& WebSock, const CString& sPageName, CTemplate& Tmpl);
functions.description: Handles a web request for a page (registered or unregistered). Return true to render and send the provided template; return false if you redirected or printed an error (or want a 404).
requirements: Called only if WebRequires* checks passed and OnWebPreRequest returned false.
Return true to have Tmpl evaluated and sent; return false if you already handled (Redirect/PrintErrorPage) or want 404.
Populate Tmpl with variables/loops before returning true.

functions.name: CModule::ValidateWebRequestCSRFCheck
functions.signature: virtual bool CModule::ValidateWebRequestCSRFCheck(CWebSock& WebSock, const CString& sPageName);
functions.description: Validates CSRF token for a web request. Must return true only if the CSRF token is valid; otherwise a CSRF error will be printed by the framework.
requirements: Implement to check per-request CSRF tokens as appropriate.
Return true only when CSRF check passes.

functions.name: CModule::AddSubPage
functions.description: Registers a subpage to appear in the web UI sidebar and to enable dispatching to it.
requirements: spSubPage must be a valid TWebSubPage object (shared/unique pointer type as defined in WebModules.h).
Safe to call multiple times to add pages.

functions.name: CModule::ClearSubPages
functions.description: Removes all previously registered subpages for this module.
requirements: Use when you need to rebuild the subpage list; all prior subpages are forgotten.

functions.name: CModule::GetSubPages
functions.description: Returns a modifiable reference to the vector of registered subpages.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid while the module lives; do not store dangling references beyond module lifetime.
Do not invalidate iterators unexpectedly for other code.

functions.name: CModule::OnEmbeddedWebRequest
functions.signature: virtual bool CModule::OnEmbeddedWebRequest(CWebSock& WebSock, const CString& sPageName, CTemplate& Tmpl);
functions.description: Embeds module-provided web content into caller-defined places (not necessarily full pages). Return value meaning depends on the embedding context; return false if you don’t need to embed content for the given place.
requirements: Behavior and expected Tmpl variables depend on the caller’s embedding context.
Should not perform long blocking operations in a web request context.

functions.name: CModule::OnPreRehash
functions.description: Called just before znc.conf is rehashed. Use to prepare for configuration reload.
requirements: Must not block for long to avoid stalling rehash.

functions.name: CModule::OnPostRehash
functions.description: Called after a successful rehash. Use to apply new configuration/state.

functions.name: CModule::OnIRCDisconnected
functions.description: Called when the user/network disconnects from the IRC server.

functions.name: CModule::OnIRCConnected
functions.description: Called after a successful connection/login to the IRC server.

functions.name: CModule::OnIRCConnecting
functions.description: Called just before establishing an IRC server connection using the provided socket. May influence or halt connection by returning HALT/HALTCORE/HALTMODS/CONTINUE.
requirements: pIRCSock is a valid pointer to the IRC socket about to connect; do not delete it.
Return appropriate EModRet to control connection handling.

functions.name: CModule::OnIRCConnectionError
functions.description: Called when a CIRCSock fails to connect or connection was halted via OnIRCConnecting(HALTCORE).
requirements: pIRCSock refers to the socket that failed; may be in error state.

functions.name: CModule::OnIRCRegistration
functions.signature: virtual CModule::EModRet CModule::OnIRCRegistration(CString& sPass, CString& sNick, CString& sIdent, CString& sRealName);
functions.description: Called before sending registration (NICK/USER/PASS) to the IRC server. Allows modifying credentials or halting processing.
requirements: sPass/sNick/sIdent/sRealName are mutable and may be changed in-place.
Return EModRet to indicate how to proceed; CONTINUE usually.

functions.name: CModule::OnBroadcast
functions.description: Called when a message is broadcast to all users. You may modify the message or halt further processing.
requirements: sMessage can be modified in-place to alter the broadcast content.

functions.name: CModule::OnChanPermission3
functions.signature: virtual void CModule::OnChanPermission3(const CNick* pOpNick, const CNick& Nick, CChan& Channel, char cMode, bool bAdded, bool bNoChange);
functions.description: Called when a user’s channel privilege changes (e.g., +o/-o), specifying the mode character. Newest variant that may have pOpNick null if set by server.
requirements: pOpNick may be nullptr when the server set the mode; check before dereferencing.
cMode is the privilege mode character (e.g., 'o' for op).
